response.justification: Bogdan is a strong, technically versatile individual contributor with genuine developer-tooling experience (custom test runners, CI/CD setup, DLang libraries) and over 15 years in the industry, but his career has stayed entirely on the IC track — there is no evidence of formal people management, direct reports, performance reviews, or organizational leadership, which are core, non-negotiable requirements for this Engineering Manager role.
strengths: Deep hands-on experience building developer tools and testing infrastructure (Trial test runner, Fluent-Asserts, CI/CD pipelines)
Broad technical range across languages, platforms (web, mobile, embedded) and system types
Demonstrated mentoring/teaching ability through workshops, talks, and Refactoring Dojos
concerns: No evidence of formal people management, direct reports, or conducting one-on-ones/performance reviews
Career progression has remained purely technical (Staff/Senior Engineer titles) with no management or team-lead titles
No indication of leading organizational change or setting cross-team strategic roadmaps
